title: 信息日报 2026-10-08

headline.title: NASA 韦布望远镜发现火星大小天体猛烈碰撞迹象
headline.summary: NASA 詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜在 21 个年轻恒星周围的“极端碎片盘”中找到尘埃证据，显示火星大小的天体曾发生剧烈碰撞。研究人员表示，这些碰撞的规模与强度可为理解太阳系早期演化提供线索，包括可能形成月球的巨大撞击。
headline.title_en: NASA's Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
headline.summary_en: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has observed 21 rare "extreme debris disks" around young stars, finding dust that reveals the scale and violence of planetary collisions. Researchers say these smash-ups may resemble the giant impact thought to have created Earth's Moon, offering clues to how our own solar system formed and evolved.
headline.original_title: NASA’s Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
headline.reason: 该研究由韦布望远镜带来，是当日科学类候选中评分最高的一条，直接关联行星形成与月球起源等公众关心的根本问题，兼具新闻价值与可读性，适合作为日报头条。
headline.reason_en: This is the day's top-scoring science item: fresh Webb observations of colliding Mars-sized worlds speak directly to planetary formation and the Moon's origin, combining strong news value with broad reader interest.
